findings.summary: Serialized evidence could admit itself without a host-provided verifier.
findings.remediation: Assessment now requires a host-injected verifier bound to policy, evidence-set and admitted receipt digests.

findings.summary: A child contract could weaken parent authority, freshness or evidence requirements.
findings.remediation: Aggregation now rejects child policy weakening before recomputing child assessment.

findings.summary: Delivery could accept a self-consistent but untrusted serialized assessment.
findings.remediation: Delivery requires a host verifier and the CLI recomputes assessment from bound inputs.

findings.summary: A contract could remove all critical evidence requirements and still report satisfied.
findings.remediation: Schema, TypeScript and Python validators require at least one critical evidence-backed required slot.

findings.summary: A fully failed model pilot could still receive an RC engineering recommendation.
findings.remediation: The scorer now blocks a recommendation when every scored run is a hard failure and validates this guard.

residual_limitations: The isolated reviewer did not produce a final message because its task was interrupted after findings were recorded.
The integration owner reproduced each finding and verified the remediations.
This review does not assess a product-specific production deployment or external effects.
claim_boundary: This is an isolated AI-assisted security review with reproduced findings and verified remediation. It is not an external human audit and does not authorize production write.
